muffin.initial_conditions.initial_conditions_2D.four_reg(num_nodes: int, num_refs: int, mu: float, sigma: float)[source]
  • num_nodes: int

    Number of nodes in the cell. Must be square number.

num_refs: int

Number of lengths in the reference set. For example, if reference set is {-1,0,+1} then num_refs==3.

  • mu: float

    Mean of underlying normal distribution. Must be non-negative.

  • sigma: float:

    Standard deviation of underlying distribution.

muffin.initial_conditions.initial_conditions_2D.six_ireg(num_nodes: int, num_refs: int, mean: float, leng_1: numpy.ndarray, mu: float, sigma: float)[source]

  • Get specified number of (x,y) points within a unit cell.

  • Calculate simplices of delauney triangulation.

  • Use simplices to get a graph.

  • Use simplices to calculate distances between connected points.

  • Use distances between points to get their conductance.

  • Add conductances to graph as weights.
